verdict.rationale: ADK is an open-source framework that can be self-hosted, run offline/disconnected, or deployed to Cloud Run/Agent Runtime/any container environment, which indirectly lets a user choose where their agent (and its data) runs. However, there is no explicit data-residency/region-selection feature, compliance certification, or documentation addressing storage location guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration options, compliance documentation (e.g., GDPR/data-locality certifications), and confirmation of where session/state data is persisted by default.
